execution_kinds.installed_host_harness: a Rust libtest executable built from the same compiler commit runs one `--exact` test per required id against the installed candidate prefix named by BESKID_V06_QUALIFIED_PREFIX; every installed CLI invocation is proven by a `beskid-installed-invocation` line in retained stderr whose digest is the installed CLI
execution_kinds.installed_native: the installed candidate CLI runs one `beskid test --json` target of the bundled Corelib test workspace; required ids must be a subset of its passed tests and nothing in the target may fail, skip, filter out or time out

provisional_cases.reason: Glue Mod contracts are deleted in 0.6.0 (v06-rust-glue-integration: Glue generation does not run Mod contracts) and no accepted or provisional change retains them; there is no implementation to evaluate. Reinstating Glue Mod execution needs a new spec change before this id can return to the mandatory set.
